Experimental. A VLAN on an Arista EOS switch, and its name.

**Experimental.** Network devices are new, and this module may change between releases. It's tested against cEOS-lab 4.37.0F on a local machine, not yet in CI.

Use `eos_vlan` to create a VLAN on an Arista EOS switch and give it a name. Removing the step deletes the VLAN, unless `on_remove = "forget"`. The change goes through a config session with a revert timer, like every EOS step, including the wait before the confirm, which since v0.10.0 is paid once per switch per apply, not once per step; see [`eos_config`](/modules/eos_config).

## Example usage

```hcl
step "users" {
  eos_vlan {
    vlan_id = 10
    name    = "users"
  }
}
```

One step per VLAN, from a map:

```hcl
step "vlans" {
  for_each = { users = 10, voice = 20, iot = 30 }

  eos_vlan {
    vlan_id = item.value
    name    = item.key
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | No | VLAN name: one word, up to 32 characters. Leave unset for the switch's default, such as VLAN0010; a name set by hand is then removed. |
| `on_remove` | string | No | What happens on the switch when this resource is removed: "delete" (default) removes the VLAN, "forget" leaves it. |
| `vlan_id` | number | Yes | VLAN ID, 1 to 4094. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_eos_vlan.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the VLAN was there, with this name, at the last refresh. |
| `revision` | string | Changes each time Conn3x changes this on the host. Handlers watch it. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_eos_vlan` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
